description: Use this when someone asks for the cheapest natural gas in Georgia, Georgia natural gas rates this month, to compare Georgia gas marketers, whether to switch gas marketers, what they would pay a year at a given usage (for example, what would I pay at 900 therms), or about current promo codes and advertised deals. Covers residential customers on Atlanta Gas Light's system. Ranks every Georgia natural gas marketer's current plans of one type by estimated annual cost, from the Georgia PSC's monthly filings. Cost = rate x therms + 12 x sign-up service charge + Atlanta Gas Light base charge. Rows the data gate refused to rank are returned unranked with the reason. Also returns current verified advertised deals across all terms, including promo codes, conditions and evidence. Present these separately alongside filed rates; do not call the PSC winner cheapest overall without comparing available advertised annual costs and terms. Read-only; does not enroll anyone. Do not use for electricity, commercial or business gas accounts, Atmos Energy or city/municipal gas systems, PSC-set Regulated Provider rates, other states, or wholesale/Henry Hub prices.

plan_type.description: fixed = standard 12-month fixed (default), variable, senior, or prepay

therms_per_year.description: Annual gas use in therms, 50 to 5000 (for example 900). Omit to use the PSC's own typical-household assumption (see assumptions in the result). The user's last 12 bills are the best source.

name: compare_rates
title: Compare Georgia gas marketer rates
